|errata_history={{Card errata/Drop! (V) (Virtual Set 3)}}
This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current version. Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then).
* '''Original''' ([[Drop! (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="ht-drop-022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/drop.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Drop!”. Text: “Deploy on table. While no card stacked here, may stack opponent's just-played Interrupt here. Opponent may use 3 Force to place an Interrupt here in Used Pile. Once per turn, may place a card from hand on bottom of Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image first published 29 June 2022 as the high-resolution PNG<ref name="ht-drop-64dc6b6">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/hires/drop.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/64dc6b661391419814310a87f9e1ba4aa09d87b2 commit 64dc6b6] (29 June 2022, “July 1 2022 errata”). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>; card-size image uploaded 1 July 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/0ab9fb866cb766f1913af967a4ab9b30668559cd commit 0ab9fb8]). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Drop!”. '''What changed:''' “Once per turn, may place” became “Once per turn, unless your protocol droid on table, may place”; the errata mark “E1” now prints. Text: “Deploy on table. While no card stacked here, may stack opponent's just-played Interrupt here. Opponent may use 3 Force to place an Interrupt here in Used Pile. Once per turn, unless your protocol droid on table, may place a card from hand on bottom of Used Pile. [Immune to Alter]”
